value.text:
The component appears to be `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`, which refreshes S3 presigned URLs to prevent staleness.

Reading `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go` and checking server startup to find the schedule and wiring site.
`s3presign` looks like the stale-link refresher. I'll read the runner and how server startup starts it.

The S3 presign runner (`s3presign.Runner`) refreshes external attachment links every 12 hours.

It is wired into server startup in `server/server.go`. `Server.Start` calls `startBackgroundRunners` at line 129. That function creates and starts the runner at lines 153–174.

h01.
s3presign.Runner — every 12 hours — server/server.go:129

The S3 presign runner (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`) re-presigns S3 attachment URLs so stored links do not expire. It ticks every 12 hours (`runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`). `Server.Start` hooks it in by calling `startBackgroundRunners`, which constructs the runner, runs it once immediately, then starts `Run` in a background goroutine.
